Refrigerators and freezers of any kind
PCs and printers
Peripheral devices such as mice, keyboards, etc. (only accepted if like new)
Computer monitors with HDMI connection
CRT televisions
Video cassettes, audio cassettes, slides, and self-recorded media
Typewriters, copying machines, and fax machines (exception: vintage typewriters)
Chemicals, containers with unidentified contents,
substances requiring disposal, liquids including (alcoholic) beverages
Food (except for announced collection campaigns)
Medications
Medical and technical equipment such as walkers, care beds, commode chairs, crutches, etc.
Diapers in original, unopened packaging
Night storage heaters and gas appliances of any kind
Chairs or seating furniture with damaged upholstery and/or stains
Stained and/or multi-part mattresses, bed bases with metal springs
Duvets and pillows (down or quilted); (exception: washed wool blankets)
Built-in beds or wardrobe beds
Leftovers from flea markets
Grand pianos (only upon prior request)
Wall units older than 15 years that must be completely dismantled,
have non-veneered side panels and/or include extensions
Bathtubs, shower cabins, toilets, bidets (only if like new)
Helmets of any kind (only accepted if new)
Child car seats (e.g. Maxi-Cosi) with a valid approval number
(first digits: ECE 129 R04 or R03)
Large quantities of office binders
Household appliances that process food, e.g. toasters,
coffee machines, mixers, hand blenders (only if like new)
Electrical appliances used in direct contact with the body, e.g. razors, epilators, curling irons (only if like new)
Magazines, encyclopedias, old specialist books, travel guides
(exception: travel guides from the last 2 years)
Shoes and textiles that are dirty, worn, and/or damaged
Non-usable goods must be dismantled into individual parts, sorted, and disposed of separately by our staff.
Each year, this amounts to approximately 600 tons, resulting in high disposal costs.
We therefore ask for your understanding if our staff are sometimes unable to accept parts of your donation.
